章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 服从参数为 2 的指数分布, 则 $Y = 2X + e^{-2X}$ 的期望 $EY = (\quad)$ .
解析:
A.

解 由于 X 服从参数为 2 的指数分布, 故 $EX = \frac{1}{2}$ . 又

$E (\mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 X}) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 x} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 x} \cdot 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 4 x} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2},$

所以 $EY = 2EX + E(\mathrm{e}^{-2X}) = 2 \times \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2}$ .

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设 $(X, Y)$ 服从二维正态分布，则 $U = X + Y$ 与 V = X - Y 不相关的充分必要条件是().
解析:
C.

解 因为 U 与 V 不相关 $\Leftrightarrow \operatorname{Cov}(U, V) = 0$ . 又由于

$\begin{array}{r l} \operatorname{Cov} (U, V) & = \operatorname{Cov} (X + Y, X - Y) \\ & = \operatorname{Cov} (X, X) - \operatorname{Cov} (X, Y) + \operatorname{Cov} (Y, X) - \operatorname{Cov} (Y, Y) \\ & = \operatorname{Cov} (X, X) - \operatorname{Cov} (Y, Y) = D X - D Y = 0, \end{array}$

故 U, V 不相关的充分必要条件是 DX = DY.

而 $DX = E(X^{2}) - (EX)^{2}$ , $DY = E(Y^{2}) - (EY)^{2}$ , 故选项 C 正确.

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 与 Y 相互独立，且均存在非零方差， $DX \neq DY$ ，则（）.
选项B: $X + Y$ 与 $X - Y$ 不相关
解析:
C.

解 由 X 与 Y 相互独立, 知 X 与 Y 不相关.

由 $\mathrm{Cov}(2X+1,2Y-1)=4\mathrm{Cov}(X,Y)=0$ , 知 $2X+1$ 与 2Y-1 不相关, 排除选项 A.

由 $\mathrm{Cov}(X+Y,X-Y)=\mathrm{Cov}(X,X)-\mathrm{Cov}(Y,Y)=DX-DY\neq0$ ，知 $X+Y$ 与 X-Y 相关，排除选项 B.

利用定义可验证 $e^{X}$ 与 $Y+1$ 相互独立.

当 $x > 0$ 时，

$\begin{array}{r l} P \left\{\mathrm{e} ^ {X} \leqslant x, Y + 1 \leqslant y \right\} & = P \left\{X \leqslant \ln x, Y \leqslant y - 1 \right\} \\ & = P \left\{X \leqslant \ln x \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y \leqslant y - 1 \right\} \\ & = P \left\{\mathrm{e} ^ {X} \leqslant x \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y + 1 \leqslant y \right\}; \end{array}$

当 $x \leqslant 0$ 时， $P\{\mathrm{e}^X \leqslant x\} = 0$ ，所以有

$P \left\{\mathrm{e} ^ {X} \leqslant x, Y + 1 \leqslant y \right\} = 0 = P \left\{\mathrm{e} ^ {X} \leqslant x \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y + 1 \leqslant y \right\}.$

故 $e^{X}$ 与 $Y+1$ 相互独立,选项 C 正确.

由 $\mathrm{Cov}(X+Y,Y+1)=\mathrm{Cov}(X,Y)+\mathrm{Cov}(Y,Y)=DY\neq0$ , 知 $X+Y$ 与 $Y+1$ 相关, 从而 $X+Y$ 与

$Y+1$ 不相互独立, 排除选项 D.

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 的概率密度为 $f(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}}\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}+2x-1}(-\infty ，+\infty)$，则 $E(X^{2})=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
$\frac{3}{2}.$

解由

$f (x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x ^ {2} + 2 x - 1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {(x - 1) ^ {2}}{2 \cdot \frac {1}{2}}},$

知 $X \sim N\left(1, \frac{1}{2}\right)$ , 故 $EX = 1, DX = \frac{1}{2}$ , 所以

$E (X ^ {2}) = D X + (E X) ^ {2} = \frac {1}{2} + 1 ^ {2} = \frac {3}{2}.$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 从 $1,2,3,4,5$ 中任取一数 $X$，再从 $1, \cdots ，X$ 中任取一数 Y，则 $EY=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
2.

解 先求 Y 的分布律.

Y 的所有可能取值为 1,2,3,4,5,由全概率公式,得

$P \{Y = k \} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {k} P \{X = i \} \cdot P \{Y = k \mid X = i \} = \frac {1}{5} \sum_ {i = k} ^ {5} \frac {1}{i} (k = 1, 2, \dots , 5),$

$E Y = \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {5} k \cdot P \{Y = k \} = \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {5} \left(k \cdot \frac {1}{5} \sum_ {i = k} ^ {5} \frac {1}{i}\right) = 2.$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 $X$ 的分布函数 $F(x) = 0.3\Phi \left(\frac{x - 4}{2}\right) + 0.7\Phi \left(\frac{x + 1}{3}\right)$ ，其中 $\Phi(x)$ 为标准正态分布的分布函数，则 $EX =$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
0.5.

解 先求 X 的概率密度, 再求 EX.

$f (x) = F ^ {\prime} (x) = 0. 3 \varphi \left(\frac {x - 4}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{2} + 0. 7 \varphi \left(\frac {x + 1}{3}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{3},$

其中 $\varphi(x)$ 为 $X \sim N(0,1)$ 的概率密度.

$\begin{array}{r l} E X & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} 0. 3 \cdot \frac {1}{2} \cdot x \varphi \left(\frac {x - 4}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} 0. 7 \cdot \frac {1}{3} \cdot x \varphi \left(\frac {x + 1}{3}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 0. 3 \times \frac {1}{2} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \varphi \left(\frac {x - 4}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x + 0. 7 \times \frac {1}{3} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \varphi \left(\frac {x + 1}{3}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 0. 3 \times \frac {1}{2} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} (2 t + 4) \varphi (t) \cdot 2 \mathrm{d} t + 0. 7 \times \frac {1}{3} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} (3 t - 1) \varphi (t) \cdot 3 \mathrm{d} t \\ & = 0. 3 \times 4 + 0. 7 \times (- 1) = 0. 5. \end{array}$

【注】① $\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}t\varphi(t)\mathrm{d}t=\mu=0.$

② 设 $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^{2})(\sigma > 0)$ ，则

$F (x) = P \{X \leqslant x \} = P \left\{\frac {X - \mu}{\sigma} \leqslant \frac {x - \mu}{\sigma} \right\} = \Phi \left(\frac {x - \mu}{\sigma}\right),$

即分布函数为 $F(x)=\Phi\left(\frac{x-\mu}{\sigma}\right)$ ，相应的随机变量 X 有 $EX=\mu$ .

③一般结论：若 $F(x)=k_{1}\Phi\left(\frac{x-\mu_{1}}{\sigma_{1}}\right)+k_{2}\Phi\left(\frac{x-\mu_{2}}{\sigma_{2}}\right)$ ，当 $k_{1}+k_{2}=1$ 时，有 $EX=k_{1}\mu_{1}+k_{2}\mu_{2}$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 $X \sim N(\mu_{1}, \sigma^{2})$ ， $Y \sim N(\mu_{2}, \sigma^{2})$ 。若 $\frac{1}{2}(X + Y)$ 与 $\frac{1}{3}(X - 2Y)$ 不相关，则 X 与 Y 的相关系数 $\rho_{XY} =$ \_\_\_\_ 。
解析:
- 1.

解 由已知,有

$\begin{array}{r l} & \mathrm{Cov} \left(\frac {X + Y}{2}, \frac {X - 2 Y}{3}\right) \\ & = \frac {1}{6} \mathrm{Cov} (X + Y, X - 2 Y) \\ & = \frac {1}{6} \left[ \mathrm{Cov} (X, X) + \mathrm{Cov} (Y, X) - 2 \mathrm{Cov} (X, Y) - 2 \mathrm{Cov} (Y, Y) \right] \\ & = \frac {1}{6} \left[ D X - \mathrm{Cov} (X, Y) - 2 D Y \right] \\ & = \frac {1}{6} (\sigma^ {2} - \rho_ {X Y} \sigma^ {2} - 2 \sigma^ {2}) = \frac {1}{6} \sigma^ {2} (- 1 - \rho_ {X Y}) = 0. \end{array}$

故 $\rho_{XY} = -1.$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设二维随机变量 $(X,Y)$ 的概率密度为 $f(x,y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&xe^{-x(1+y)},&x>0,y>0,\\ &0,& 其他,\end{aligned}\right.$ 则 $P\{X>2\mid X>EX\}=$
解析:
$e^{-1}$

解 先求 X 的边缘概率密度.

当 $x \leqslant 0$ 时, $f_{X}(x) = 0$ ;

当 $x > 0$ 时， $f_{X}(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x, y) \mathrm{d}y = \int_{0}^{+\infty} x \mathrm{e}^{-x(1 + y)} \mathrm{d}y = \mathrm{e}^{-x}$ .

故

$f _ {X} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}, & x > 0, \\ 0, & x \leqslant 0, \end{array} \right.$

即 $X \sim E(1)$ ，所以 EX = 1。

由指数分布的无记忆性,有

$\begin{array}{r l} P \{X > 2 \mid X > E X \} & = P \{X > 2 \mid X > 1 \} = P \{X > 1 + 1 \mid X > 1 \} \\ & = P \{X > 1 \} = 1 - P \{X \leqslant 1 \} \\ & = 1 - (1 - e ^ {- 1}) = e ^ {- 1}. \end{array}$

第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 $X, Y, Z$ 满足 $EX = EY = 1$, $EZ = -1$. $DX = DY = DZ = 1$, $\rho_{XY} = 0$ , $\rho_{XZ} = \frac{1}{2}$ , $\rho_{YZ} = -\frac{1}{2}$ , 求 $E(X + Y - 2Z)$ , $D(X + Y + Z)$ .
解析:
解

$\begin{array}{r l} E (X + Y - 2 Z) & = E X + E Y - 2 E Z \\ & = 1 + 1 - 2 \times (- 1) = 4, \end{array}$

$\begin{array}{r l} D (X + Y + Z) & = D X + D Y + D Z + 2 \mathrm{Cov} (X, Y) + \\ & \quad 2 \mathrm{Cov} (X, Z) + 2 \mathrm{Cov} (Y, Z). \end{array}$

而

$\operatorname{Cov} (X, Y) = \sqrt {D X \cdot D Y} \cdot \rho_ {X Y} = 1 \times 0 = 0,$

$\operatorname{Cov} (X, Z) = \sqrt {D X \cdot D Z} \cdot \rho_ {x z} = 1 \times \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{2},$

$\operatorname{Cov} (Y, Z) = \sqrt {D Y \cdot D Z} \cdot \rho_ {\mathrm{YZ}} = 1 \times \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right) = - \frac {1}{2},$

故

$D (X + Y + Z) = 1 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 2 \times \frac {1}{2} + 2 \times \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right) = 3.$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容:
设 $X$ 的概率密度为 $f(x) = \frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{-|x|} (-\infty < x < +\infty)$ .
(I) 求 EX 和 DX;
(II) 求 $Cov(X, |X|)$ ，并判别 X 与 $|X|$ 是否不相关；
(III) 问 X 与 $|X|$ 是否相互独立?
解析:
解 (I)

$\begin{array}{r l} E X & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \frac {1}{2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- | x |} \mathrm{d} x = 0 (\text {奇函数}), \\ D X & = E (X ^ {2}) - (E X) ^ {2} = E (X ^ {2}) \\ & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \mathrm{d} x = 2. \end{array}$

(Ⅱ)

$\operatorname{Cov} (X, | X |) = E (X | X |) - E X \cdot E (| X |) = E (X | X |).$

而

$E (X \mid X \mid) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \mid x \mid f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \mid x \mid \frac {1}{2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- | x |} \mathrm{d} x = 0,$

故 $\mathrm{Cov}(X, |X|) = 0$ ，即 X 与 $|X|$ 不相关.

（Ⅲ）对任意给定的 $0 < a < +\infty$ ，显然事件 $\{|X| \leqslant a\}$ 包含于事件 $\{X \leqslant a\}$ ，且

$P \{X \leqslant a \} < 1, P \{| X | \leqslant a \} > 0,$

故

$P \{X \leqslant a, | X | \leqslant a \} = P \{| X | \leqslant a \}.$

但

$P \{X \leqslant a \} \cdot P \{| X | \leqslant a \} < P \{| X | \leqslant a \},$

从而

$P \{X \leqslant a, | X | \leqslant a \} \neq P \{X \leqslant a \} \cdot P \{| X | \leqslant a \},$

因此， $X$ 与 $|X|$ 不相互独立.

【注】①本题验证 X 与 $\left|X\right|$ 不相互独立，是用定义证明的，若用两个随机变量 X 与 Y 的联合概率密度 $f(x,y)$ 是否等于 $f_{X}(x)\cdot f_{Y}(y)$ 来证明，则会带来烦琐的计算.

② 本题也可看出：X, Y 不相关 $\Rightarrow X$ , Y 相互独立.

又

$\begin{array}{r l} & D (X Y) = E [ (X Y) ^ {2} ] - [ E (X Y) ] ^ {2} = E [ (X Y) ^ {2} ] - (E X \cdot E Y) ^ {2}, \\ & D X \cdot D Y = [ E (X ^ {2}) - (E X) ^ {2} ] [ E (Y ^ {2}) - (E Y) ^ {2} ] \\ & \quad = E (X ^ {2}) \cdot E (Y ^ {2}) - E (X ^ {2}) (E Y) ^ {2} - (E X) ^ {2} E (Y ^ {2}) + (E X) ^ {2} (E Y) ^ {2}, \end{array}$

【注】当 X, Y 相互独立时, 有结论:

$D (X Y) = D X D Y + (E X) ^ {2} D Y + (E Y) ^ {2} D X.$

事实上，由 X, Y 相互独立，知 $X^{2}$ 与 $Y^{2}$ 相互独立（反之不一定成立），故

$\begin{array}{r l} D (X Y) & = E [ (X Y) ^ {2} ] - [ E (X Y) ] ^ {2} = E (X ^ {2}) \cdot E (Y ^ {2}) - (E X) ^ {2} \cdot (E Y) ^ {2} \\ & = [ D X + (E X) ^ {2} ] [ D Y + (E Y) ^ {2} ] - (E X) ^ {2} \cdot (E Y) ^ {2} \\ & = D X D Y + (E X) ^ {2} D Y + (E Y) ^ {2} D X. \end{array}$

解析:
A.

解 判别 X 与 Y 是否相关,需计算 $\mathrm{Cov}(X,Y)$ .

由 $X \sim N(0,1)$ , 知

$E X = 0, \quad D X = 1, \quad E (X ^ {2}) = D X + (E X) ^ {2} = 1, \quad E (X ^ {3}) = 0,$

$E (X Y) = E [ X (X ^ {2} + X + 1) ] = E (X ^ {3}) + E (X ^ {2}) + E X = 0 + 1 + 0 = 1,$

所以 $\mathrm{Cov}(X,Y)=E(XY)-EXEY=1-0=1\neq0$ ，故 X 与 Y 不是不相关，即 X 与 Y 相关，由此知 X 与 Y 一定不独立。故选项 A 正确。

A.

解 $\rho_{YZ} = \frac{\mathrm{Cov}(Y,Z)}{\sqrt{DY}\cdot\sqrt{DZ}}.$ 又

$\operatorname{Cov} (Y, Z) = \operatorname{Cov} (Y, a X + b) = a \operatorname{Cov} (X, Y), \quad D Z = D (a X + b) = a ^ {2} D X,$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 在 $\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ 上服从均匀分布, $U = \sin X, V = \cos X$ , 则 U 与 V 的相关系数 $\rho_{UV}$ 为().

解 由 $X \sim U\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ , 知 $X$ 的概率密度为 $f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{2}{\pi}, & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}, \\ 0, & \text{其他}, \end{cases}$ 故

$E U = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {2}{\pi} \sin x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {2}{\pi},$

$E (U ^ {2}) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) \sin^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {2}{\pi} \sin^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2},$

$D U = E (U ^ {2}) - (E U) ^ {2} = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {4}{\pi^ {2}}.$

同理可得 $EV = \frac{2}{\pi}, DV = \frac{1}{2} - \frac{4}{\pi^2}$ . 又

$E (U V) = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {2}{\pi} \sin x \cos x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{\pi},$

$\operatorname{Cov} (U, V) = E (U V) - E U \cdot E V = \frac {1}{\pi} - \frac {4}{\pi^ {2}} < 0,$

故 $-1 < \rho_{UV} = \frac{\mathrm{Cov}(U,V)}{\sqrt{DU} \cdot \sqrt{DV}} < 0$ . 选项 D 正确.

题目内容: 设随机变量 X 服从参数为 $\lambda(\lambda>0)$ 的泊松分布, Y 服从参数为 $\frac{1}{\sqrt{\lambda}}$ 的指数分布, 则 $\rho_{XY}=1$ 的充分必要条件是().

知

$\begin{array}{r l} \rho_ {X Y} & = \frac {\mathrm{Cov} (X , Y)}{\sqrt {D X} \cdot \sqrt {D Y}} = \frac {\mathrm{Cov} (X , Y)}{D X} = \frac {\mathrm{Cov} (X , Y)}{\mathrm{Cov} (X , X)}, \\ \rho_ {X Y} & = 1 \Leftrightarrow \mathrm{Cov} (X, Y) = \mathrm{Cov} (X, X) \\ & \Leftrightarrow \mathrm{Cov} (X, Y - X) = 0 \\ & \Leftrightarrow \mathrm{Cov} (X - Y, X) = 0, \end{array}$

$E (X + Y) = E X + E Y = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f (- y) \mathrm{d} y,$

$\int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f (- y) \mathrm{d} y \stackrel {- y = x} {=} \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {- \infty} (- x) f (x) \mathrm{d} (- x) = - \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x,$

故 $E(X+Y)=0$ ，即EX=-EY.

$\begin{array}{r l} E (Y ^ {2}) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} f (- y) \mathrm{d} y \xlongequal {- y = x} \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {- \infty} (- x) ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm{d} (- x) \\ & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = E (X ^ {2}), \end{array}$

$D Y = E (Y ^ {2}) - (E Y) ^ {2} = E (X ^ {2}) - (- E X) ^ {2} = E (X ^ {2}) - (E X) ^ {2} = D X = 1,$

第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 服从参数为 $\lambda$ 的泊松分布，已知 $P\{X > 0\} = 1 - e^{-1}$ ，则 $Cov(X, X^{2}) = (\quad)$ .
解析:
D.

解 由已知, $P\{X=0\}=\frac{\lambda^{0}}{0!}\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda}=\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda},P\{X=0\}=1-P\{X>0\}=\mathrm{e}^{-1}$ ，故 $e^{-\lambda}=e^{-1}$ ，从而 $\lambda=1$ .
故

$E X = \lambda = 1, E (X ^ {2}) = D X + (E X) ^ {2} = \lambda + \lambda^ {2} = 1 + 1 ^ {2} = 2.$

$E (X ^ {3}) = \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {n ^ {3}}{n !} \lambda^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda} = \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {n ^ {3}}{n !} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} = \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {n ^ {3}}{n !}.$

而

$\begin{array}{r l} \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {n ^ {3}}{n !} & = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {n ^ {2}}{(n - 1) !} = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(n - 1) ^ {2} + 2 (n - 1) + 1}{(n - 1) !} \\ & = \sum_ {n = 2} ^ {\infty} \frac {n - 1 + 2}{(n - 2) !} + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{(n - 1) !} \\ & = \sum_ {n = 2} ^ {\infty} \frac {n - 2 + 3}{(n - 2) !} + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{(n - 1) !} \\ & = \sum_ {n = 3} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{(n - 3) !} + 3 \sum_ {n = 2} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{(n - 2) !} + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{(n - 1) !} \\ & = e + 3 e + e = 5 e, \end{array}$

于是 $E(X^{3}) = \mathrm{e}^{-1} \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{n^{3}}{n!} = 5.$ 故 $\operatorname{Cov}(X, X^{2}) = E(X^{3}) - EX \cdot E(X^{2}) = 5 - 1 \times 2 = 3.$ 选项 D 正确.

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 在区间 $(0,2)$ 内服从均匀分布，$Y$ 在 $(0,X)$ 内服从均匀分布，则 $Cov(X,Y)=()$ .
解析:
D.

解 依题设,知 X 的概率密度为

$f _ {X} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2}, & 0 < x < 2, \\ 0, & \text {其他.} \end{array} \right. f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{x}, & 0 < y < x, \\ 0, & \text {其他,} \end{array} \right.$

故 $(X,Y)$ 的概率密度为

$f (x, y) = f _ {X} (x) \bullet f _ {Y | X} (y \mid x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2 x}, & 0 < x < 2, 0 < y < x, \\ 0, & \text {其他}. \end{array} \right.$

当 $y \leqslant 0$ 或 $y \geqslant 2$ 时， $f_{Y}(y) = 0$ ;

当 $0 < y < 2$ 时，有 $f_{Y}(y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x, y) \mathrm{d}x = \int_{y}^{2} \frac{1}{2x} \mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2} (\ln 2 - \ln y)$ .

故 $Y$ 的概率密度为

$f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2} (\ln 2 - \ln y), & 0 < y < 2, \\ 0, & \text {其他}, \end{array} \right.$

$E X = \frac {0 + 2}{2} = 1,$

$\begin{array}{r l} E Y & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {2} y \cdot \frac {1}{2} (\ln 2 - \ln y) \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \left(\int_ {0} ^ {2} \ln 2 \cdot y \mathrm{d} y - \int_ {0} ^ {2} y \ln y \mathrm{d} y\right) = \frac {1}{2}, \end{array}$

$\begin{array}{r l} E (X Y) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x y f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} x y \cdot \frac {1}{2 x} \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} y \mathrm{d} y = \frac {2}{3}. \end{array}$

故 $\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y) = E(XY) - EX \cdot EY = \frac{2}{3} - 1 \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{6}$ .

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 的概率分布为 $P\{X=k\}=\frac{C}{k!}\quad(k=0,1,2,\cdots)$ ，则 $E(X^{2})=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
2.

解 根据概率分布的性质, $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\frac{C}{k!}=Ce=1$ ,可得 $C=e^{-1}$ .

注意到 X 服从泊松分布, $P\{X=k\}=\frac{\lambda^{k}}{k!}\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda}(k=0,1,2,\cdots)$ ,对比 $P\{X=k\}=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-1}}{k!}(k=0,1,2,\cdots)$ ,

$E X = D X = \lambda = 1,$

所以 $E(X^{2}) = DX + (EX)^{2} = 1 + 1^{2} = 2.$

【注】常用分布的期望、方差公式应记住，利用方差公式 $DX = E(X^{2}) - (EX)^{2}$ 求 $E(X^{2})$ 是常用的方法.

设随机变量 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 独立同分布, 且有相同的概率密度, 则概率
$$P \left\{X _ {n} > \min \left\{X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \dots , X _ {n - 1} \right\} \right\} = \underline {{{}}}.$$
解析:

$\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Y} (y) & = P \{Y \leqslant y \} = P \{\min \{X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \dots , X _ {n - 1} \} \leqslant y \} \\ & = 1 - P \{X _ {1} > y \} \cdot P \{X _ {2} > y \} \cdot \dots \cdot P \{X _ {n - 1} > y \} \\ & = 1 - [ 1 - F _ {1} (y) ] ^ {n - 1}, \end{array}$

故 $f_{Y}(y) = F_{Y}^{\prime}(y) = (n - 1)[1 - F_{1}(y)]^{n - 2}\cdot f_{1}(y)$ ，所以

$\begin{array}{r l} P \{X _ {n} > Y \} & = \iint_ {x > y} f _ {n} (x) (n - 1) f _ {1} (y) [ 1 - F _ {1} (y) ] ^ {n - 2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f _ {n} (x) \mathrm{d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {x} (n - 1) f _ {1} (y) [ 1 - F _ {1} (y) ] ^ {n - 2} \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f _ {n} (x) \left\{- [ 1 - F _ {1} (y) ] ^ {n - 1} \Big | _ {- \infty} ^ {x} \right\} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \{1 - [ 1 - F _ {1} (x) ] ^ {n - 1} \} f _ {n} (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 1 + \frac {[ 1 - F _ {1} (x) ] ^ {n}}{n} \Big | _ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} = 1 - \frac {1}{n}. \end{array}$

$\frac{1}{\pi}\ln2+\frac{1}{2}.$

解 用期望的定义计算.

$E (\min \{| X |, 1 \}) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \min \{| x |, 1 \} \cdot f (x) \mathrm{d} x.$

当 $|x| < 1$ 时， $\min \{|x|, 1\} = |x|$ ；当 $|x| \geqslant 1$ 时， $\min \{|x|, 1\} = 1$ ，所以

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \min \{| x |, 1 \} f (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \frac {1}{\pi} \left(\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \frac {| x |}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {- 1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}} + \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}}\right) \\ & = \frac {2}{\pi} \left(\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{1 + x ^ {2}}\right) = \frac {1}{\pi} \ln 2 + \frac {1}{2}. \end{array}$

第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设二维随机变量 $(X,Y)$ 服从 D 上的均匀分布, 其中 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant3,0\leqslant y\leqslant3\right\}$ . 记 $U=(X+Y)^{2}, V=(X-Y)^{2}$ , 则 $Cov(U,V)=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
$-\frac{27}{20}.$

解 由二维均匀分布的性质,知 X 与 Y 都服从 $[0,3]$ 上的均匀分布,且 X 与 Y 相互独立,其边缘概率密度为

$f _ {X} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{3}, & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 3, \\ 0, & \text {其他}, \end{array} \right. f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{3}, & 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 3, \\ 0, & \text {其他}. \end{array} \right.$

$E X = E Y = \frac {3}{2}, D X = D Y = \frac {3}{4}, E (X ^ {2}) = E (Y ^ {2}) = 3,$

$E (X ^ {4}) = \int_ {0} ^ {3} {\frac {1}{3}} x ^ {4} \mathrm{d} x = {\frac {8 1}{5}}, E (Y ^ {4}) = {\frac {8 1}{5}}, D (X ^ {2}) = D (Y ^ {2}) = {\frac {8 1}{5}} - 9 = {\frac {3 6}{5}}.$

故

$\begin{array}{r l} \operatorname{Cov} (U, V) & = \operatorname{Cov} [ (X + Y) ^ {2}, (X - Y) ^ {2} ] \\ & = \operatorname{Cov} (X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} + 2 X Y, X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} - 2 X Y) \\ & = D (X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2}) - 4 D (X Y). \end{array}$

由 X 与 Y 相互独立, 知 $X^{2}$ 与 $Y^{2}$ 也相互独立, 有

$D (X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2}) = D (X ^ {2}) + D (Y ^ {2}) = \frac {7 2}{5},$

$D (X Y) = E (X Y) ^ {2} - (E X Y) ^ {2} = E (X ^ {2}) E (Y ^ {2}) - (E X E Y) ^ {2} = 9 - \frac {8 1}{1 6} = \frac {6 3}{1 6}.$

故 $\operatorname{Cov}(U, V) = \frac{72}{5} - \frac{63}{4} = -\frac{27}{20}$ .

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 $X$ 与 $Y$ 相互独立，且 $X \sim N(0,1)$ ， $Y \sim B\left(4, \frac{1}{4}\right)$ ，则 $XY$ 与 $X - Y$ 的相关系数为 \_\_\_\_。
解析:
$\frac{4}{7}.$

解 XY 与 X - Y 的相关系数

$\rho = \frac {\operatorname{Cov} (X Y , X - Y)}{\sqrt {D (X Y)} \sqrt {D (X - Y)}}.$

由 $X \sim N(0,1)$ , 知

$E X = 0, \quad D X = 1, \quad E (X ^ {2}) = D X + (E X) ^ {2} = 1.$

由 $Y \sim B\left(4, \frac{1}{4}\right)$ , 知

$E Y = 4 \times \frac {1}{4} = 1, D Y = 4 \times \frac {1}{4} \times \frac {3}{4} = \frac {3}{4},$

$E (Y ^ {2}) = D Y + (E Y) ^ {2} = \frac {3}{4} + 1 = \frac {7}{4},$

$\begin{array}{r l} \operatorname{Cov} (X Y, X - Y) & = E [ X Y (X - Y) ] - E (X Y) E (X - Y) \\ & = E (X ^ {2} Y - X Y ^ {2}) - E X E Y (E X - E Y) \\ & = E (X ^ {2}) E Y - E X E (Y ^ {2}) - 0 = 1 \times 1 = 1, \end{array}$

$D (X - Y) = D X + D Y = 1 + \frac {3}{4} = \frac {7}{4},$

故

$\rho = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\frac {7}{4}} \times \sqrt {\frac {7}{4}}} = \frac {4}{7}.$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设某商品的销售额 $X$ 是一个随机变量, $X$ 在 $(a, b)$ $(b > a > 0)$ 内服从均匀分布, 销售利润函数为 $Y =\left\{\begin{aligned}&4X-2(h-X),&X\leqslant h\\ &4h,&X>h\end{aligned}\right.$, $(a < h < b)$. 当期望销售利润最大时, $h = \_\_\_\_$.
解析:
$\frac{2b+a}{3}.$

解 由已知, X 的概率密度为 $f(x)=\left\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{b-a},&a\end{aligned}\right. $故

$E Y = \int_ {0} ^ {h} [ 4 x - 2 (h - x) ] f (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {h} ^ {+ \infty} 4 h f (x) \mathrm{d} x$

$\begin{array}{l} {= 6 \int_ {0} ^ {h} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x - 2 h \int_ {0} ^ {h} f (x) \mathrm{d} x + 4 h \left[ 1 - \int_ {0} ^ {h} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right]} \\ {= 6 \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {h} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x - h \int_ {0} ^ {h} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right] + 4 h.} \end{array}$

令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}h} EY = -6\int_{0}^{h}f(x)\mathrm{d}x + 4 = 0$ ，得 $\int_0^h f(x)\mathrm{d}x = \frac{2}{3}$ 又

$\int_ {0} ^ {h} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {a} ^ {h} {\frac {\mathrm{d} x}{b - a}} = {\frac {h - a}{b - a}} = {\frac {2}{3}},$

解得 $h = \frac{2b + a}{3}$ .

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
解析:
解（I）依题设， $X_{i}(i=1,2,\cdots,n)$ 相互独立，且都在 $(0,1)$ 内服从均匀分布，其概率密度为 $f(x)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&1,\\&0\end{aligned}\right.  $其分布函数为

$F (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0, & x \leqslant 0, \\ x, & 0 < x < 1, \\ 1, & x \geqslant 1. \end{array} \right.$

$d = \max \{X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \dots , X _ {n} \} - \min \{X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \dots , X _ {n} \} \stackrel {\text {记}} {=} X _ {(n)} - X _ {(1)},$

其中 $X_{(n)}$ 的概率密度为

$f _ {(n)} (x) = n [ F (x) ] ^ {n - 1} \bullet f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} n x ^ {n - 1}, & 0 < x < 1, \\ 0, & \text {其他}, \end{array} \right.$

$X_{(1)}$ 的概率密度为

$f _ {(1)} (x) = n [ 1 - F (x) ] ^ {n - 1} \bullet f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} n (1 - x) ^ {n - 1}, & 0 < x < 1, \\ 0, & \text {其他}, \end{array} \right.$

故

$E X _ {(n)} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot f _ {(n)} (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \cdot n x ^ {n - 1} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {n}{n + 1},$

$E X _ {(1)} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot f _ {(1)} (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \cdot n (1 - x) ^ {n - 1} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{n + 1},$

所以

$E d = E X _ {(n)} - E X _ {(1)} = \frac {n}{n + 1} - \frac {1}{n + 1} = \frac {n - 1}{n + 1}.$

（Ⅱ）先求 $Y$ 的分布，用 $X$ 表示在 $(0,1)$ 内任取的数，则 $X$ 在 $(0,1)$ 内服从均匀分布，其概率密度为 $f(x) = \begin{cases} 1, & 0 < x < 1, \\ 0, & \text{其他.} \end{cases}$ 记 $A = \left\{X > \frac{2}{3}\right\}$ ，则

$P (A) = P \left\{X > \frac {2}{3} \right\} = \int_ {\frac {2}{3}} ^ {1} 1 \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{3}.$

由已知， $Y \sim B\left(n, \frac{1}{3}\right)$ ，所以 $EY = n \cdot p = \frac{n}{3}$ ， $DY = np(1 - p) = \frac{2n}{9}$ .

【注】设 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 独立同分布，其分布函数为 $F(x)$ ，则：

① $\max\{X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\}$ 的分布函数为 $[F(x)]^{n}$ ;

② $\min\{X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\}$ 的分布函数为 $1-\left[1-F(x)\right]^{n}$ .

第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容:
设随机变量 $X_{1}, X_{2}, X_{3}$ 相互独立, 且均服从参数为 $\lambda$ 的指数分布, 记 $Y = \min\{X_{1}, X_{2}\}$ ,
$T=\max\{Y,X_{3}\}.$ 求:
(I) $Y$ 的概率密度 $f_{Y}(y)$ ;
(II) 期望 $ET$.
解析:
解 (I) 由已知, $X_{1}$ 与 $X_{2}$ 相互独立, 故 $(X_{1}, X_{2})$ 的概率密度为

$f (x _ {1}, x _ {2}) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \lambda^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda (x _ {1} + x _ {2})}, & x _ {1} > 0, x _ {2} > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其他}. \end{array} \right.$

设 $Y$ 的分布函数为 $F_{Y}(y)$ ，则当 $y \leqslant 0$ 时， $F_{Y}(y) = 0$ ；当 $y > 0$ 时，有

$\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Y} (y) & = P \{\min \{X _ {1}, X _ {2} \} \leqslant y \} = 1 - P \{X _ {1} > y, X _ {2} > y \} \\ & = 1 - P \{X _ {1} > y \} \cdot P \{X _ {2} > y \} = 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda y} \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda y} = 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 \lambda y}, \\ f _ {Y} (y) & = F _ {Y} ^ {\prime} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 \lambda \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 \lambda y}, & y > 0, \\ 0, & y \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right. \end{array}$

故

(Ⅱ) 先求 T 的分布函数和概率密度.

当 $t \leqslant 0$ 时, $F_{T}(t) = 0$ ; 当 $t > 0$ 时, 有

$F _ {T} (t) = P \{T \leqslant t \} = P \{\max \{Y, X _ {3} \} \leqslant t \} = P \{Y \leqslant t, X _ {3} \leqslant t \}.$

而 $Y = \min \{X_{1}, X_{2}\}$ 与 $X_{3}$ 相互独立，故

$F _ {T} (t) = P \{Y \leqslant t \} \cdot P \{X _ {3} \leqslant t \} = (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 \lambda t}) (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda t}),$

所以

于是

$\begin{array}{r l} f _ {T} (t) & = F _ {T} ^ {\prime} (t) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \lambda \mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda t} + 2 \lambda \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 \lambda t} - 3 \lambda \mathrm{e} ^ {- 3 \lambda t}, & t > 0, \\ 0, & t \leqslant 0, \end{array} \right. \\ E T & = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} t \cdot (\lambda \mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda t} + 2 \lambda \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 \lambda t} - 3 \lambda \mathrm{e} ^ {- 3 \lambda t}) \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \frac {1}{\lambda} + \frac {1}{2 \lambda} - \frac {1}{3 \lambda} = \frac {7}{6 \lambda}. \end{array}$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容:
设 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 相互独立同分布, 其相同的概率密度为
$$f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 (x - \theta)}, & x > \theta , \\ 0, & x \leqslant \theta \end{array} (\theta \text {为常数}), \right.$$
求 $Z=\min_{1\leqslant i\leqslant n}\left\{X_{i}\right\}$ 的数学期望.
解析:
解 对于 n 个随机变量的函数的期望计算, 先求 Z 的分布函数, 从而得 Z 的概率密度, 再用期望定义计算.

由已知, $X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}$ 共同的分布函数为

$F (x) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 (x - \theta)}, & x > \theta , \\ 0, & x \leqslant \theta . \end{array} \right.$

Z 的分布函数为

$\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Z} (z) & = P \{Z \leqslant z \} = P \{\min _ {1 \leqslant i \leqslant n} \{X _ {i} \} \leqslant z \} = 1 - P \{\min _ {1 \leqslant i \leqslant n} \{X _ {i} \} > z \} \\ & = 1 - P \{X _ {1} > z, X _ {2} > z, \dots , X _ {n} > z \} \\ & = 1 - P \{X _ {1} > z \} P \{X _ {2} > z \} \dots P \{X _ {n} > z \} \\ & = 1 - [ 1 - F (z) ] ^ {n} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - e ^ {- 2 n (z - \theta)}, & z > \theta , \\ 0, & z \leqslant \theta , \end{array} \right. \end{array}$

于是 $Z$ 的概率密度为

$f _ {Z} (z) = F _ {Z} ^ {\prime} (z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 n \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 n (z - \theta)}, & z > \theta , \\ 0, & z \leqslant \theta , \end{array} \right.$

故

$E Z = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} z f _ {Z} (z) \mathrm{d} z = \int_ {\theta} ^ {+ \infty} 2 n z \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 n (z - \theta)} \mathrm{d} z = \theta + \frac {1}{2 n}.$

设 $X_{1}$ 与 $X_{2}$ 相互独立, $X_{i} \sim B(i, p) (i = 1, 2; 0 < p < 1)$ . 令

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容:
设随机变量 X 与 Y 相互独立，且均服从 $N(0,1)$ ，记
$$U = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} > 1, \\ 0, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1, \end{array} \right. \quad V = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} > 2, \\ 0, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 2. \end{array} \right.$$
求:
$(I)(U,V)$ 的概率分布;
(II) $\rho_{UV}$ .
解析:
解（Ⅰ）由已知， $(X,Y)$ 的概率密度为

$f (x, y) = f _ {X} (x) \bullet f _ {Y} (y) = \frac {1}{2 \pi} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2})},$

其中 $-\infty < x < +\infty, -\infty < y < +\infty$ ，故

$\begin{array}{r l} P \{U = 0 \} & = P \{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1 \} = \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {1}{2 \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} r ^ {2}} r \mathrm{d} r = 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}, \end{array}$

$\begin{array}{r l} P \{V = 0 \} & = P \{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 2 \} = \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 2} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {1}{2 \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} r ^ {2}} r \mathrm{d} r = 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}, \end{array}$

$P \{U = 0, V = 1 \} = P \{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1, X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} > 2 \} = 0,$

$P \{U = 0, V = 0 \} = P \left\{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1, X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 2 \right\} = P \left\{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1 \right\} = 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}},$

$P \{U = 1, V = 1 \} = 1 - \left(1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) - \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}\right) = \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}.$

故 $(U,V)$ 的概率分布为

|V\\U|0|1|V|
|---|---|---|---|
|0|$1 - e^{-\frac{1}{2}}$|$e^{-\frac{1}{2}} - e^{-1}$|$1 - e^{-1}$|
|1|0|$e^{-1}$|$e^{-1}$|
|U|$1 - e^{-\frac{1}{2}}$|$e^{-\frac{1}{2}}$|—|

(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知, UV 的分布为

|UV|0|1|
|---|---|---|
|P|1 - e^\{-1\}|e^\{-1\}|

故

$E (U V) = 0 \times (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}) + 1 \times \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} = \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}.$

由（I）知，

$E U = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}, D U = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right),$

$E V = \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}, \quad D V = \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}),$

所以

$\begin{array}{r l} \rho_ {U V} & = \frac {\mathrm{Cov} (U , V)}{\sqrt {D U} \cdot \sqrt {D V}} = \frac {E (U V) - E U E V}{\sqrt {D U} \cdot \sqrt {D V}} \\ & = \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}}{\sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}})} \sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1})}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} + 1}}. \end{array}$

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设 X 与 Y 相互独立，且均服从 $N(\mu, \sigma^{2})$ ，求 $E(\max\{X, Y\})$ .
解析:
解 将 X, Y 化为标准正态分布.

令 $X_{1} = \frac{X - \mu}{\sigma}, Y_{1} = \frac{Y - \mu}{\sigma}$ ，则 $X_{1}$ 与 $Y_{1}$ 独立，且均服从 $N(0,1)$ ，故 $X = \mu + \sigma X_{1}, Y = \mu + \sigma Y_{1}$ . 于是

$\begin{array}{r l} \max \{X, Y \} & = \max \{\mu + \sigma X _ {1}, \mu + \sigma Y _ {1} \} = \mu + \sigma \max \{X _ {1}, Y _ {1} \}, \\ E (\max \{X, Y \}) & = \mu + \sigma E (\max \{X _ {1}, Y _ {1} \}). \end{array}$

下面求 $E(\max\{X_{1},Y_{1}\})$ .

利用公式 $\max \{X_1, Y_1\} = \frac{1}{2}(X_1 + Y_1 + |X_1 - Y_1|)$ ，得

$E (\max \{X _ {1}, Y _ {1} \}) = \frac {1}{2} [ E X _ {1} + E Y _ {1} + E (| X _ {1} - Y _ {1} |) ] = \frac {1}{2} E (| X _ {1} - Y _ {1} |).$

又 $X_{1}, Y_{1}$ 相互独立，且都服从 $N(0,1)$ ，故 $X_{1} - Y_{1} \sim N(0,2)$ ，所以

$\begin{array}{r l} E (| X _ {1} - Y _ {1} |) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \cdot \sqrt {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2 \times 2}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \frac {2}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \times \sqrt {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{4}} \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {2}{\sqrt {\pi}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{d} \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{4}}\right) = \frac {2}{\sqrt {\pi}}, \end{array}$

故 $E(\max \{X_1,Y_1\}) = \frac{1}{2}\times \frac{2}{\sqrt{\pi}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}}$ ，所以 $E(\max \{X,Y\}) = \mu +\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{\pi}}.$

【注】 结论：

$① \max \{X _ {1}, Y _ {1} \} = \frac {1}{2} (X _ {1} + Y _ {1} + | X _ {1} - Y _ {1} |).$

$② \min \{X _ {1}, Y _ {1} \} = \frac {1}{2} (X _ {1} + Y _ {1} - | X _ {1} - Y _ {1} |).$

同理可得 $E(\min\{X,Y\})=\mu-\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{\pi}}$ .

③ 若直接利用随机变量的函数的期望公式计算, 即

$E (\max \{X _ {1}, Y _ {1} \}) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \max \{x _ {1}, y _ {1} \} f (x _ {1}, y _ {1}) d x d y,$

其中 $\max\{x_{1},y_{1}\}=\begin{cases}x_{1},&x_{1}>y_{1},\\y_{1},&x_{1}\leqslant y_{1},\end{cases}$ 则计算二重积分较烦琐.

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
题目内容: 设随机变量 X 的概率密度为 $f(x)=\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}\sqrt{\pi}}\mathrm{e}^{x(2-x)}, x\in(-\infty,+\infty), Y=\sqrt{2}(X-EX)$ ，求 $\rho_{XY}$ 与 $D(Y^{2})$ .
解析:
解由

$f (x) = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} \sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm{e} ^ {x (2 - x)} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- (x - 1) ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \cdot \sqrt {\frac {1}{2}}} \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {(x - 1) ^ {2}}{2 \times \frac {1}{2}}},$

可知 $X \sim N\left(1, \frac{1}{2}\right)$ , 故

$E X = 1, \quad D X = \frac {1}{2}, \quad Y = \sqrt {2} (X - E X) = \sqrt {2} (X - 1) \sim N (0, 1),$

从而 $EY = 0, DY = 1$ ,

$\begin{array}{r l} \operatorname{Cov} (X, Y) & = \operatorname{Cov} [ X, \sqrt {2} (X - 1) ] = \operatorname{Cov} (X, \sqrt {2} X) - \operatorname{Cov} (X, \sqrt {2}) \\ & = \sqrt {2} \operatorname{Cov} (X, X) - [ E (\sqrt {2} X) - E X \cdot E \sqrt {2} ] \\ & = \sqrt {2} D X - \sqrt {2} E X + \sqrt {2} E X \\ & = \sqrt {2} \times \frac {1}{2} = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}, \end{array}$

故

$\rho_ {X Y} = \frac {\mathrm{Cov} (X , Y)}{\sqrt {D X} \cdot \sqrt {D Y}} = \frac {\frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}}{\sqrt {\frac {1}{2}} \cdot \sqrt {1}} = 1.$

由 $Y \sim N(0,1)$ , 知 $Y^2 \sim \chi^2(1)$ . 故 $D(Y^2) = 2$ .

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
解析:
解（Ⅰ）用定义法，有

$\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Z} (z) & = P \left\{Z \leqslant z \right\} = P \left\{X _ {1} X _ {3} \leqslant z \right\} \\ & = P \left\{X _ {1} X _ {3} \leqslant z, X _ {3} = - 1 \right\} + P \left\{X _ {1} X _ {3} \leqslant z, X _ {3} = 1 \right\} \\ & = P \left\{- X _ {1} \leqslant z, X _ {3} = - 1 \right\} + P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant z, X _ {3} = 1 \right\} \\ & = P \left\{X _ {3} = - 1 \right\} P \left\{X _ {1} \geqslant - z \right\} + P \left\{X _ {3} = 1 \right\} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant z \right\} \\ & = \frac {1}{4} (1 - P \left\{X _ {1} < - z \right\}) + \frac {3}{4} P \left\{X _ {1} \leqslant z \right\} \\ & = \frac {1}{4} [ 1 - \Phi (- z) ] + \frac {3}{4} \Phi (z) = \frac {1}{4} \Phi (z) + \frac {3}{4} \Phi (z) = \Phi (z), \end{array}$

其中 $\Phi(z)$ 为 $N(0,1)$ 的分布函数, 故

$f _ {Z} (z) = \Phi^ {\prime} (z) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2}} (- \infty < z < + \infty).$

(Ⅱ)

$\begin{array}{r l} \operatorname{Cov} (Z, X _ {1}) & = \operatorname{Cov} (X _ {1} X _ {3}, X _ {1}) = E (X _ {1} X _ {3} \cdot X _ {1}) - E (X _ {1} X _ {3}) E X _ {1} \\ & = E (X _ {1} ^ {2} X _ {3}) - (E X _ {1}) ^ {2} E X _ {3}. \end{array}$

由 $X_{1} \sim N(0,1)$ , 知 $EX_{1} = 0, DX_{1} = 1$ . 又 $X_{1}^{2}$ 与 $X_{3}$ 相互独立, 所以

$E (X _ {1} ^ {2} X _ {3}) = E (X _ {1} ^ {2}) E X _ {3},$

$E (X _ {1} ^ {2}) = D X _ {1} + (E X _ {1}) ^ {2} = 1 + 0 ^ {2} = 1,$

$E X _ {3} = (- 1) \times \frac {1}{4} + 1 \times \frac {3}{4} = \frac {1}{2},$

$\operatorname{Cov} (Z, X _ {1}) = \frac {1}{2}.$

又 $Z \sim N(0,1)$ , 故 $DZ = 1$ , 从而

$\rho_ {X _ {1} Z} = \frac {\operatorname{Cov} (Z , X _ {1})}{\sqrt {D Z} \cdot \sqrt {D X _ {1}}} = \frac {\frac {1}{2}}{\sqrt {1} \times \sqrt {1}} = \frac {1}{2}.$

（Ⅲ）由 $X_{1}$ 与 $X_{2}$ 均服从 $N(0,1)$ ，知 $\overline{X} = \frac{X_1 + X_2}{2}$ 与样本方差 $S^2$ 相互独立，而

$S ^ {2} = \left(X _ {1} - \frac {X _ {1} + X _ {2}}{2}\right) ^ {2} + \left(X _ {2} - \frac {X _ {1} + X _ {2}}{2}\right) ^ {2} = \frac {(X _ {1} - X _ {2}) ^ {2}}{2},$

所以 $X_{1} + X_{2}$ 与 $(X_{1} - X_{2})^{2}$ 相互独立，故 $(X_{1} + X_{2})^{2}$ 与 $(X_{1} - X_{2})^{2}$ 相互独立.

章节: 第四章 随机变量的数字特征
解析:
解（I）由 $X_{1}$ 与 $X_{2}$ 相互独立及 $X_{1} \sim B(1, p)$ , $X_{2} \sim B(2, p)$ , 可知

$\operatorname{Cov} \left(X _ {1}, X _ {2}\right) = 0, \quad D X _ {1} = p (1 - p), \quad D X _ {2} = 2 p (1 - p).$

由于

$\begin{array}{r l} \mathrm{Cov} (Y _ {1}, Y _ {2}) & = \mathrm{Cov} (2 X _ {1} + X _ {2}, X _ {1} - X _ {2}) = 2 D X _ {1} - D X _ {2} - \mathrm{Cov} (X _ {1}, X _ {2}) \\ & = 2 p (1 - p) - 2 p (1 - p) = 0, \end{array}$

故

$\rho_ {Y _ {1} Y _ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{Cov} (Y _ {1} , Y _ {2})}{\sqrt {D Y _ {1}} \sqrt {D Y _ {2}}} = 0.$

(Ⅱ) 由于

$\{Y _ {1} = 0 \} = \{2 X _ {1} + X _ {2} = 0 \} = \{X _ {1} = 0, X _ {2} = 0 \},$

$\left\{Y _ {2} = 0 \right\} = \left\{X _ {1} - X _ {2} = 0 \right\} = \left\{X _ {1} = 0, X _ {2} = 0 \right\} \cup \left\{X _ {1} = 1, X _ {2} = 1 \right\},$

$P \left\{Y _ {1} = 0 \right\} \cdot P \left\{Y _ {2} = 0 \right\} < P \left\{Y _ {1} = 0 \right\}$

从而有 $P\{Y_1 = 0, Y_2 = 0\} \neq P\{Y_1 = 0\} \cdot P\{Y_2 = 0\}$ ，即 $Y_1$ 与 $Y_2$ 不相互独立.

【注】此题说明两个随机变量不相关是它们相互独立的必要条件而非充分条件.
